# Purpose

This file is the complete rolling-origin forecast analysis. It preferentially reads saved analytic objects, but can reuse objects already present in the current R session and can rebuild the 2020 municipality geometry/adjacency graph if needed.

It reads the saved analytic objects directly from RDS files, then performs nine one-year-ahead folds:

- train through 2016 -> predict 2017
- train through 2017 -> predict 2018
- ...
- train through 2024 -> predict 2025

Existing prediction CSVs are detected and skipped automatically. If a fit RDS exists but its prediction CSV is missing, the saved fit is loaded and the prediction is extracted without refitting.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = TRUE, message = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(lubridate)
  library(sf)
  library(spdep)
  library(INLA)
})

STUDY_START <- 2016L
STUDY_END   <- 2025L
TARGET_YEARS <- 2017:2025
EXPECTED_N_MUNI <- 5570L

# Main output location used throughout the revision.
RESULT_ROOT <- path.expand("~/Downloads/inla_results")
ROLL_DIR <- file.path(RESULT_ROOT, "rolling_origin")
FIT_DIR <- file.path(ROLL_DIR, "fits")
PRED_DIR <- file.path(ROLL_DIR, "predictions")

dir.create(FIT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(PRED_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Saved-input search locations.
# The helper checks the project working directory first, then the revision
# results folder. Add another directory here if you keep the RDS files elsewhere.
INPUT_DIRS <- unique(c(
  normalizePath(".", winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE),
  path.expand("~/Downloads/inla_results"),
  path.expand("~/Downloads")
))

find_input <- function(filename) {
  candidates <- file.path(INPUT_DIRS, filename)
  hit <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)]
  if (length(hit) == 0L) {
    stop(
      "Required input not found: ", filename, "\n",
      "Searched:\n", paste(candidates, collapse = "\n")
    )
  }
  normalizePath(hit[1], winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
}

cat("Rolling-origin forecast years:", paste(TARGET_YEARS, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Fit directory:", FIT_DIR, "\n")
cat("Prediction directory:", PRED_DIR, "\n")
```

# 1. Read saved analytic objects

Preferred saved files:

- `Chik_total.rds`
- `pop_panel_total.rds`
- `muni_sf_2020.rds`
- `brazil_muni_2020.adj`

`Chik_total` and `pop_panel_total` may instead come from the current R session. The municipality geometry and adjacency graph are rebuilt when saved versions are unavailable.

```{r load-saved-inputs}
# Prefer saved objects so this notebook can be resumed independently.
# If they are absent, use objects already present in the current R session.
# Municipality geometry and adjacency can be rebuilt from geobr if needed.

load_or_session <- function(filename, object_name) {
  candidates <- file.path(INPUT_DIRS, filename)
  hit <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)]

  if (length(hit) > 0L) {
    path <- normalizePath(hit[1], winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
    cat(object_name, "loaded from:", path, "
")
    return(readRDS(path))
  }

  if (exists(object_name, envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)) {
    cat(object_name, "reused from current R session.
")
    return(get(object_name, envir = .GlobalEnv))
  }

  stop(
    "Required input unavailable: ", object_name,
    ". Looked for ", filename,
    " in INPUT_DIRS and in the current R session."
  )
}

Chik_total <- load_or_session("Chik_total.rds", "Chik_total")
pop_panel_total <- load_or_session("pop_panel_total.rds", "pop_panel_total")

muni_candidates <- file.path(INPUT_DIRS, "muni_sf_2020.rds")
muni_hit <- muni_candidates[file.exists(muni_candidates)]

if (length(muni_hit) > 0L) {
  muni_sf <- readRDS(muni_hit[1])
  cat("Municipality geometry loaded from:", muni_hit[1], "
")
} else if (exists("muni_sf", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)) {
  muni_sf <- get("muni_sf", envir = .GlobalEnv)
  cat("Municipality geometry reused from current R session.
")
} else {
  cat("muni_sf_2020.rds not found; rebuilding 2020 municipality geometry with geobr.
")
  muni_sf <- geobr::read_municipality(
    year = 2020,
    showProgress = FALSE
  ) %>%
    sf::st_make_valid()
}

muni_sf <- muni_sf %>%
  mutate(
    code_muni = str_pad(
      substr(as.character(code_muni), 1, 6),
      width = 6,
      side = "left",
      pad = "0"
    )
  )

space_levels <- muni_sf$code_muni

stopifnot(
  length(space_levels) == EXPECTED_N_MUNI,
  !anyDuplicated(space_levels),
  all(Chik_total$CLASSI_FIN %in% c(1, 13)),
  n_distinct(pop_panel_total$code_muni) == EXPECTED_N_MUNI
)

graph_candidates <- file.path(INPUT_DIRS, "brazil_muni_2020.adj")
graph_hit <- graph_candidates[file.exists(graph_candidates)]

if (length(graph_hit) > 0L) {
  g <- INLA::inla.read.graph(graph_hit[1])
  cat("Adjacency graph loaded from:", graph_hit[1], "
")
} else {
  graph_path <- file.path(ROLL_DIR, "brazil_muni_2020.adj")
  cat("Adjacency graph not found; rebuilding at:", graph_path, "
")

  nb <- spdep::poly2nb(
    muni_sf,
    queen = TRUE
  )

  spdep::nb2INLA(
    file = graph_path,
    nb = nb
  )

  g <- INLA::inla.read.graph(graph_path)
}

cat("Municipalities in fixed 2020 spatial universe:", length(space_levels), "
")
```

# 2. Standardize population panel

```{r population-panel}
pop_panel_total_std <- pop_panel_total %>%
  transmute(
    code_muni = str_pad(
      substr(as.character(code_muni), 1, 6),
      width = 6,
      side = "left",
      pad = "0"
    ),
    year = as.integer(year),
    POP = as.numeric(total_pop)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    year %in% STUDY_START:STUDY_END,
    code_muni %in% space_levels
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(pop_panel_total_std) == EXPECTED_N_MUNI * length(STUDY_START:STUDY_END),
  n_distinct(pop_panel_total_std$code_muni) == EXPECTED_N_MUNI,
  n_distinct(pop_panel_total_std$year) == length(STUDY_START:STUDY_END),
  !anyDuplicated(pop_panel_total_std[c("code_muni", "year")]),
  sum(is.na(pop_panel_total_std$POP)) == 0L,
  sum(pop_panel_total_std$POP <= 0) == 0L
)

cat("Population rows:", nrow(pop_panel_total_std), "\n")
```

# 3. Build the complete 2016-2025 municipality-month panel

Zero observed notifications remain zero in the complete grid, matching the primary model.

```{r full-panel}
all_months <- seq(
  as.Date(sprintf("%d-01-01", STUDY_START)),
  as.Date(sprintf("%d-12-01", STUDY_END)),
  by = "month"
)

confirmed_monthly <- Chik_total %>%
  transmute(
    code_muni = str_pad(
      substr(as.character(ID_MUNICIP), 1, 6),
      width = 6,
      side = "left",
      pad = "0"
    ),
    ym_date = floor_date(as.Date(DT_SIN_PRI), unit = "month"),
    is_confirmed = CLASSI_FIN %in% c(1, 13)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is_confirmed,
    !is.na(code_muni),
    !is.na(ym_date),
    ym_date >= min(all_months),
    ym_date <= max(all_months),
    code_muni %in% space_levels
  ) %>%
  count(code_muni, ym_date, name = "cases")

panel_full <- tidyr::crossing(
  ym_date = all_months,
  code_muni = space_levels
) %>%
  mutate(year = lubridate::year(ym_date)) %>%
  left_join(
    confirmed_monthly,
    by = c("code_muni", "ym_date")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cases = replace_na(cases, 0L)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    pop_panel_total_std,
    by = c("code_muni", "year")
  ) %>%
  arrange(ym_date, code_muni)

stopifnot(
  nrow(panel_full) == EXPECTED_N_MUNI * 120L,
  n_distinct(panel_full$code_muni) == EXPECTED_N_MUNI,
  sum(is.na(panel_full$POP)) == 0L,
  sum(panel_full$POP <= 0) == 0L
)

cat("Full 2016-2025 panel rows:", nrow(panel_full), "\n")
cat("Confirmed cases in panel:", sum(panel_full$cases), "\n")
```

# 4. Model specification

This mirrors the primary negative-binomial model:

- free `log(POP)` coefficient
- BYM2 municipality spatial effect
- RW2 monthly temporal effect
- IID municipality-month interaction

```{r model-formula}
forecast_formula <- cases ~
  log(POP) +
  f(
    space,
    model = "bym2",
    graph = g,
    scale.model = TRUE,
    hyper = list(
      prec = list(
        prior = "pc.prec",
        param = c(1, 0.01)
      ),
      phi = list(
        prior = "pc",
        param = c(0.5, 2/3)
      )
    )
  ) +
  f(
    time,
    model = "rw2",
    constr = TRUE,
    hyper = list(
      prec = list(
        prior = "pc.prec",
        param = c(1, 0.01)
      )
    )
  ) +
  f(
    st_id,
    model = "iid",
    hyper = list(
      prec = list(
        prior = "pc.prec",
        param = c(2, 0.01)
      )
    )
  )
```

# 5. Build one rolling-origin fold

For target year `t`, all years before `t` are observed and the entire target year is set to `NA`. INLA therefore produces fitted/predictive summaries for the held-out target year.

```{r build-fold-function}
build_forecast_fold <- function(target_year) {

  stopifnot(target_year %in% TARGET_YEARS)

  fold <- panel_full %>%
    filter(year <= target_year) %>%
    mutate(
      cases_actual = cases,
      cases = if_else(
        year == target_year,
        NA_integer_,
        as.integer(cases)
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(ym_date, code_muni)

  fold_months <- sort(unique(fold$ym_date))

  fold <- fold %>%
    mutate(
      space = match(code_muni, space_levels),
      time = match(ym_date, fold_months)
    )

  n_space <- length(space_levels)

  fold <- fold %>%
    mutate(
      st_id = (time - 1L) * n_space + space
    )

  expected_train_rows <-
    EXPECTED_N_MUNI * 12L * (target_year - STUDY_START)

  expected_forecast_rows <-
    EXPECTED_N_MUNI * 12L

  stopifnot(
    sum(!is.na(fold$cases)) == expected_train_rows,
    sum(is.na(fold$cases)) == expected_forecast_rows,
    !anyNA(fold$space),
    !anyNA(fold$time),
    !anyNA(fold$st_id),
    !anyNA(fold$POP)
  )

  fold
}
```

# 6. Fit or recover one target year

This function is resumable:

1. If the prediction CSV already exists, it is read and returned.
2. If the prediction is missing but the fit RDS exists, the fit is loaded and the prediction is extracted.
3. Only if neither exists is INLA fitted again.

```{r fit-one-fold-function}
fit_one_fold <- function(target_year) {

  fit_path <- file.path(
    FIT_DIR,
    sprintf("fit_rolling_predict_%d.rds", target_year)
  )

  pred_path <- file.path(
    PRED_DIR,
    sprintf("forecast_annual_predict_%d.csv", target_year)
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # A. Prediction already exists: do not refit.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (file.exists(pred_path)) {

    cat(
      "\nPrediction already exists for",
      target_year,
      "- skipping fit.\n"
    )

    return(
      readr::read_csv(
        pred_path,
        show_col_types = FALSE,
        col_types = cols(
          code_muni = col_character(),
          .default = col_guess()
        )
      ) %>%
        mutate(
          code_muni = str_pad(
            substr(as.character(code_muni), 1, 6),
            6,
            pad = "0"
          ),
          target_year = as.integer(target_year)
        )
    )
  }

  cat("\n============================================================\n")
  cat("FITTING TARGET YEAR:", target_year, "\n")
  cat(
    "Training window:",
    STUDY_START,
    "-",
    target_year - 1L,
    "\n"
  )

  fold <- build_forecast_fold(target_year)

  cat("Training rows:", sum(!is.na(fold$cases)), "\n")
  cat("Forecast rows:", sum(is.na(fold$cases)), "\n")
  cat("============================================================\n\n")

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # B. Load existing fit if available.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (file.exists(fit_path)) {

    cat(
      "Fit RDS already exists for",
      target_year,
      "- loading saved fit and extracting prediction.\n"
    )

    fit <- readRDS(fit_path)

  } else {

    cat("No saved fit found; starting INLA.\n")
    print(Sys.time())

    fit <- INLA::inla(
      forecast_formula,
      family = "nbinomial",
      data = fold,

      control.predictor = list(
        compute = TRUE,
        link = 1
      ),

      control.compute = list(
        dic = FALSE,
        waic = FALSE,
        cpo = FALSE,
        mlik = FALSE,
        return.marginals = FALSE,
        return.marginals.predictor = FALSE,
        openmp.strategy = "huge"
      ),

      num.threads = "1:1",
      verbose = TRUE
    )

    saveRDS(
      fit,
      fit_path,
      compress = FALSE
    )

    cat("Saved fit:", fit_path, "\n")
  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # C. Extract target-year annual forecast.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  stopifnot(
    nrow(fit$summary.fitted.values) == nrow(fold)
  )

  target_pred <- fold %>%
    mutate(
      fitted_mean = fit$summary.fitted.values$mean
    ) %>%
    filter(year == target_year) %>%
    group_by(code_muni) %>%
    summarise(
      target_year = target_year,
      forecast_annual = sum(fitted_mean),
      forecast_monthly_max = max(fitted_mean),
      forecast_all_finite = all(is.finite(fitted_mean)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  stopifnot(
    nrow(target_pred) == EXPECTED_N_MUNI,
    n_distinct(target_pred$code_muni) == EXPECTED_N_MUNI,
    all(target_pred$target_year == target_year)
  )

  readr::write_csv(
    target_pred,
    pred_path
  )

  cat("Saved annual predictions:", pred_path, "\n")

  target_pred
}
```

# 7. Run all nine folds safely

A failed fold does not stop later years. Existing predictions are skipped.

```{r run-primary, eval=TRUE}
all_predictions <- list()

for (yy in TARGET_YEARS) {

  cat("\n\nPREDICT", yy, "\n")

  all_predictions[[as.character(yy)]] <- tryCatch(
    fit_one_fold(yy),
    error = function(e) {

      cat("\nERROR in target year", yy, ":\n")
      cat(conditionMessage(e), "\n")

      tibble(
        code_muni = character(),
        target_year = integer(),
        forecast_annual = numeric(),
        forecast_monthly_max = numeric(),
        forecast_all_finite = logical()
      )
    }
  )

  gc()
}
```

# 8. Bind prediction summaries without type conflicts

```{r bind-predictions}
prediction_summary <- all_predictions %>%
  purrr::map(
    ~ .x %>%
      mutate(
        code_muni = as.character(code_muni)
      )
  ) %>%
  bind_rows()

completed_years <- sort(
  unique(prediction_summary$target_year)
)

completed_years <- completed_years[
  completed_years %in% TARGET_YEARS
]

missing_years <- setdiff(
  TARGET_YEARS,
  completed_years
)

cat(
  "Completed target years:",
  paste(completed_years, collapse = ", "),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Missing target years:",
  ifelse(
    length(missing_years) == 0,
    "none",
    paste(missing_years, collapse = ", ")
  ),
  "\n"
)
```

# 9. Disk-based completion check

The prediction CSVs are the authoritative completion marker.

```{r disk-check}
pred_files_on_disk <- list.files(
  PRED_DIR,
  pattern = "^forecast_annual_predict_[0-9]{4}\\.csv$",
  full.names = FALSE
)

years_on_disk <- as.integer(
  sub(
    "forecast_annual_predict_([0-9]{4})\\.csv",
    "\\1",
    pred_files_on_disk
  )
)

years_on_disk <- sort(
  years_on_disk[years_on_disk %in% TARGET_YEARS]
)

cat(
  "Prediction files on disk:",
  paste(years_on_disk, collapse = ", "),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Number of completed rolling-origin folds:",
  length(years_on_disk),
  "of",
  length(TARGET_YEARS),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Still missing:",
  ifelse(
    length(setdiff(TARGET_YEARS, years_on_disk)) == 0,
    "none",
    paste(
      setdiff(TARGET_YEARS, years_on_disk),
      collapse = ", "
    )
  ),
  "\n"
)
```

# 10. Final status

```{r final-status}
if (length(years_on_disk) == length(TARGET_YEARS)) {

  cat("\n============================================================\n")
  cat("PRIMARY ROLLING-ORIGIN FORECAST COMPLETE\n")
  cat("Nine target years available: 2017-2025\n")
  cat("Proceed to File 15 for scoring and figure generation.\n")
  cat("============================================================\n")

} else {

  cat("\n============================================================\n")
  cat("ROLLING-ORIGIN FORECAST INCOMPLETE\n")
  cat(
    "Missing years:",
    paste(
      setdiff(TARGET_YEARS, years_on_disk),
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    "\n"
  )
  cat("Rerun this file; completed prediction CSVs will be skipped.\n")
  cat("============================================================\n")
}
```
